case_number: Civil Appeal No. __ of 2024 (Arising out of SLP(C) No. 33094 of 2017)

parties.respondent: The State of Punjab and Another

summary: The appeal challenged the Punjab and Haryana High Court's dismissal of a writ petition seeking to quash The Khalsa University (Repeal) Act, 2017. The appellants argued that the repeal was arbitrary, mala fide, discriminatory, and violative of Article 14, citing political vendetta and lack of intelligible differentia. The respondents defended the repeal as protecting the heritage status of Khalsa College and avoiding confusion. The Court examined manifest arbitrariness, classification under Article 14, and legitimacy of legislative action.
legal_provisions_cited: Shayara Bano v. Union of India and Others
Chandan Banerjee and Others v. Krishna Prosad Ghosh and Others
State of Tamil Nadu and Another v. National South Indian River Interlinking Agriculturist Association
